evaluation_dataset_mirror.images: directory junction to the original images (read-only use)
evaluation_dataset_mirror.labels: copied to temp mirror so Ultralytics *.cache files do not touch the original dataset

method.class_restriction: NMS restricted to class index 0 (pedestrian) for both models
method.ap: Ultralytics mAP: IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95, 10 thresholds; conf=0.001; NMS IoU=0.7; max_det=1000
method.precision_recall_f1_reported: Ultralytics P/R/F1 at the confidence maximizing mean F1, plus fixed conf=0.25 IoU=0.50 greedy matching P/R/F1
method.speed: Ultralytics validator speed (preprocess/inference/postprocess ms per image)
